rule: Only ids listed here may be used. Anything absent must be rejected, not improvised. Each entry points at a spec folder containing the full contract.

components.name: AIAction
components.intent: The decision point at the end of every AI recommendation. Primary confirms, secondary reviews, tertiary dismisses.
forbiddenUsage: Standard product actions that are not AI-generated
Rendering when no decision is being requested

components.name: AIAgentStack
components.intent: Several agents working at once, and what each of them is doing.
forbiddenUsage: Status conveyed only by ring colour

components.name: AIAgentWorkNote
components.intent: Show what the agent is doing without exposing raw reasoning.

components.name: AIApprovalCard
components.intent: A consequential proposal, and the human decision about it, in an order that cannot be got wrong.
forbiddenUsage: A rationale link with nothing behind it
An error state with no explanation

components.name: AIAvatar
components.intent: The mark that tells a user a machine is speaking.
forbiddenUsage: Adding a gradient or orange ring
Using it as a human avatar

components.name: AIButton
components.intent: Commit to something a machine proposed.

components.name: AIChipBrief
components.intent: Whether an agent task brief is ready to run — and whether a human still has to say yes.

components.name: AIChipHandoff
components.intent: Show the moment accountability changed hands.

components.name: AIChipMemory
components.intent: Tell the user when the system is drawing on something it learned earlier.
forbiddenUsage: Implying memory that does not exist

components.name: AIChipQuick
components.intent: Offer a starting point so the user does not face an empty box.

components.name: AIConfidenceRiskBadge
components.intent: State how sure the model is and how much is at stake, before the human decides.
forbiddenUsage: Use as a generic status badge

components.name: AIControlBar
components.intent: The human can always stop the machine.

components.name: AIDialogSlim
components.intent: Where the human writes to the machine.
forbiddenUsage: Use as a general text input

components.name: AIDialogButton
components.intent: A quiet control in the composer toolbar that does not compete with the message.

components.name: AIFeedbackBar
components.intent: Let the human correct the record.

components.name: AIIcon
components.intent: A treatment layer over standard icons — not a new icon set.
gaps: The handoff-trail, completion-settle, nudge, shimmer and alert-ring motions from the source system are not implemented. Only spin and pulse.

components.name: AILauncher
components.intent: The way in. Recognisable, confident, never instructional.

components.name: AILoadingIndicator
components.intent: Say that the machine is working, truthfully.

components.name: AIMessageBody
components.intent: AI prose, kept plain so the interface does not lend it authority the model has not earned.
forbiddenUsage: Simulated typing delay on already-complete text

components.name: AIMessageFooter
components.intent: Where the user says yes to what the response offered.
forbiddenUsage: Consequential approval without a review signal

components.name: AIMessageHeader
components.intent: Establish who is speaking before the user reads a word.
forbiddenUsage: A generic "AI" label where a specific agent name exists

components.name: AIProgress
components.intent: Progress for work that can be blocked or escalated, not merely slow.
gaps: The segmented and header variants from the source design system are not implemented. Linear only.

components.name: AIQueueBadge
components.intent: The state of one item in an agent queue, readable at a glance.

components.name: AIResponse
components.intent: One AI turn, assembled so attribution, progress and recourse are present by construction.

components.name: AISoftSurface
components.intent: The wash that says everything inside this boundary was machine-generated.

components.name: AITextLink
components.intent: An inline link inside AI prose whose label stands on its own.

components.name: AIWhyThisLink
components.intent: Make the reasoning reachable in one interaction.
forbiddenUsage: Rendering with no rationale behind it
Opening a panel without moving focus
Use as a general help link

components.name: PageContainer
components.intent: One max-width, one gutter, one place to change either.
forbiddenUsage: Use inside a dialog or sheet

components.name: FormField
components.intent: A labelled control with its description and error, wired together correctly.
forbiddenUsage: Asterisk as the only required indicator

components.name: Accordion
components.intent: Let a long page stay scannable by collapsing detail the user can open on demand.

components.name: Alert
components.intent: A message that stays on the page because it remains true.
forbiddenUsage: Colour as the only error signal

components.name: AlertDialog
components.intent: Stop the user before something irreversible happens, and make cancelling the easy path.
forbiddenUsage: Confirm button labelled OK or Yes
Initial focus on the confirm action
Collecting input inside an alert dialog

components.name: AspectRatio
components.intent: Reserve the right shape before the content arrives, so nothing jumps.

components.name: Avatar
components.intent: Identify a person or entity at a glance, and degrade gracefully when the image is missing.

components.name: Badge
components.intent: A short label that classifies the thing next to it.
gaps: Carries hover and focus-visible styling despite rendering a non-focusable div. Do not read that as permission to make it interactive.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.intent: Show where this page sits in the hierarchy, and offer a way back up.

components.name: Button
components.intent: The single most important decision available in a region, and every lesser one alongside it.
forbiddenUsage: Two primary buttons in one action region
Icon-only button with no accessible name

components.name: Calendar
components.intent: Pick a date when the surrounding days matter to the choice.
forbiddenUsage: Calendar as the only date-entry route
Allowing invalid dates then rejecting on submit
Using a day grid for distant historical dates

components.name: Card
components.intent: Group related content into a unit the eye reads as one thing.
forbiddenUsage: onClick on the Card div with no focusable child
gaps: CardTitle renders a div rather than a heading element. Supply your own heading semantics where page structure depends on it.

components.name: Carousel
components.intent: Move horizontally through a set of items when vertical space genuinely will not stretch.
forbiddenUsage: Unjustified carousel where a grid would work

components.name: Checkbox
components.intent: An independent yes-or-no choice, or one of several non-exclusive options.
forbiddenUsage: Using a checkbox where exactly one option must be chosen

components.name: Collapsible
components.intent: One thing that opens and closes, with no group to coordinate.
forbiddenUsage: Using Collapsible for a group where Accordion belongs
gaps: Entirely unstyled — no animation, chevron or spacing. Unlike every other component here, you supply all of it.

components.name: Command
components.intent: Find and run anything by typing, without knowing where it lives in the interface.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.intent: Actions for the specific thing the user right-clicked.
forbiddenUsage: Primary interaction on a touch surface

components.name: Dialog
components.intent: Interrupt the user for a self-contained task that must finish before anything else continues.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.intent: A list of actions revealed from a button, with proper menu semantics.

components.name: Form
components.intent: Wires a control to its label, description and error message so the accessibility relationships are correct by construction.
forbiddenUsage: Parts used outside their required parent
Manual aria-invalid on a wrapped control
gaps: Does not move focus to the first invalid field on submit — implement that in your onInvalid handler.

components.name: HoverCard
components.intent: A rich preview of what a link points to, without making the user go there.

components.name: Input
components.intent: A single line of user-supplied text, with the focus and disabled behavior already correct.
forbiddenUsage: Error communicated by border colour alone

components.name: Label
components.intent: Names a control, and makes its text a click target for it.
forbiddenUsage: Asterisk as the only required indicator

components.name: Menubar
components.intent: A persistent application menu bar, in the desktop-software sense.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.intent: Primary site navigation, with room for a rich panel under each top-level item.

components.name: Pagination
components.intent: Move through a result set that is too large to show at once.
gaps: No page-state logic, no boundary disabling, no live-region announcement. All presentational.

components.name: Popover
components.intent: Contextual content anchored to a trigger, without blocking the page.
forbiddenUsage: Nesting a modal dialog inside a popover

components.name: Progress
components.intent: Show how much of a known quantity of work is done.
gaps: The indeterminate state is not visually distinguished. Use a spinner instead.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.intent: Exactly one choice from a small set, with every option visible.

components.name: ResizableHandle
components.intent: Let the user decide how to divide the space.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.intent: A scrollable region with a scrollbar that looks the same on every platform.

components.name: Select
components.intent: One choice from a list too long to show all at once.

components.name: Separator
components.intent: A visible break between groups, without implying they are different kinds of thing.
forbiddenUsage: Vertical separator in a parent with no height

components.name: Sheet
components.intent: A modal panel anchored to a screen edge, for content that needs more room than a dialog affords.
forbiddenUsage: Using a sheet for content that must stay visible while working

components.name: Sidebar
components.intent: A complete application navigation shell — collapsible, persistent, responsive, and keyboard-reachable.
forbiddenUsage: Icon-collapsible menu buttons with no tooltip
Page tokens instead of sidebar tokens

components.name: Skeleton
components.intent: Show the shape of what is coming, so the wait feels shorter and the layout does not jump.
forbiddenUsage: Skeleton with no announced loading state
Shapes that do not match the eventual content
gaps: Provides no live-region semantics of its own. The announcement is yours to add every time.

components.name: Slider
components.intent: An approximate value along a continuous range, where the relative position matters more than the exact number.
forbiddenUsage: A slider as the only way to enter a precise value
A slider with fewer than ten meaningful steps

components.name: Toaster
components.intent: The same job as ui:toaster, through a different library with a simpler imperative API.
gaps: Depends on next-themes (^0.4.6) for theme detection, while the rest of the app toggles the dark class directly. The two can disagree.
Exports a component named Toaster, colliding with ui:toaster. Only one may be mounted.

components.name: Switch
components.intent: A setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped.
forbiddenUsage: A switch inside a form with a submit button

components.name: Table
components.intent: Data with real rows and columns, where comparing across both matters.
gaps: No sorting, filtering, pagination, selection or virtualisation. scope is not applied automatically to TableHead.

components.name: Tabs
components.intent: Switch between peer views of the same subject, where only one is relevant at a time.

components.name: Textarea
components.intent: Multi-line text where the length is genuinely open-ended.
forbiddenUsage: A hard character limit with no visible or announced counter

components.name: Toast
components.intent: Confirm that something happened, without taking the user away from what they are doing.

components.name: Toaster
components.intent: The one place toasts actually render.

components.name: Toggle
components.intent: A control that stays pressed — formatting state in a toolbar, not an action.
forbiddenUsage: Icon-only toggle with no accessible name
Using Toggle for an immediate setting

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.intent: A set of related toggles that share a value and a visual group.
forbiddenUsage: Icon-only items with no accessible name

components.name: Tooltip
components.intent: Name a control whose purpose is not obvious from its appearance.
forbiddenUsage: Tooltip as the only accessible name
